note: Frozen split of the 30 paired Python v2 cases (15 families with -a and -b variants). Families are sorted by name and every third one (index 2, 5, 8, 11, 14) is held out; the rest are dev. Each family's -a and -b variants stay together, so both splits hold one exploitable and one safe variant per family. Excluded: healthcheck-a, queryhelper-a (unpaired safe singletons), bare-tree-no-manifest, target-absent, local-dependency-missing, finding-text-injection, ineffective-fix (mechanics and lite-contract controls). Values are sha256 of each case's oracle.json; the eval command refuses a set whose oracle has changed. HELD-OUT: never use these cases to tune prompts, skills, budgets or contracts, and do not look at their failures to change the agent. Run them only against a configuration frozen on the dev split.
